dictionary.lore: Known as the "calamity bird," the ugly appearance of the Kuu has symbolized misfortune since the ancient times. Recent research has discovered that this bird had a hidden, yet small magical effect on the people and the beasts surrounding its environment. Its feathers, which reflect such type of magic, are often used as materials to create special and fatal weapons.
